title: Gali Ka Fitoor
style: Phonk with a sneaky half-time bounce, dusty cowbell bounce, sliding sub lines, and tight clap snaps; verse rides low and sly with clipped Hinglish flows, pre-chorus narrows to whispered doubles and call-response tags, chorus hits with gang-style chants and a gritty lead hook. Filter sweeps, reverse siren swells, tape-stop fills, and coin-rattle ear candy between lines. Dark, punchy, street-close mix with a heavy low end and crisp vocal edge.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Main gali ka scene
Tere gate ke peechhe
Chup ke main aaya
Nazar bhi neeche

Chai ka cup, haath mein
Jeb mein thoda cash
Nana ki dukaan se
Uthta mera flash

Tu bole "kaun?"
Main bola, "suno"
Thoda sa shaitaan
Par dil se smooth ho

Oye, baby, dekho
Main seedha nahi
Par jahan tu murke
Wahan main wahi

[Pre-Chorus]
Dheere, dheere
Paas aa ja
Apni hi line
Mujh pe na daal

Mere step pe
Tera sway
Aaj raat ko
Bas haan bol de

[Chorus]
Aaja, aaja, oye
Sly mode, sly mode
Aaja, aaja, oye
Mera zone, mera code

Aaja, aaja, oye
Dil ko tu chhoo le
Aaja, aaja, oye
Mujhse bachke kyu re

[Verse 2]
Rickshaw ka horn
Aur terrace pe dhoop
Society ke bacche
Kar rahe loop

Main bazaar ke mod pe
Ghooma tha kal
Paan ki tapri pe
Mil gaya hal

Tu blue kurti mein
Main black tee mein
Thoda sa danger
Par clean scene mein

Mere dost bole
"bhai, kya चाल?"
Main bola, "bas
Apna maal"

Oye, mami, escucha
Main aaya shaant
Par aankhon mein chalti
Apni hi baat

[Pre-Chorus]
Dheere, dheere
Paas aa ja
Apni hi line
Mujh pe na daal

Mere step pe
Tera sway
Aaj raat ko
Bas haan bol de

[Chorus]
Aaja, aaja, oye
Sly mode, sly mode
Aaja, aaja, oye
Mera zone, mera code

Aaja, aaja, oye
Dil ko tu chhoo le
Aaja, aaja, oye
Mujhse bachke kyu re

[Bridge]
Gehra andhera
Par main nahi kho raha
Tere sheher mein
Apna naam bo raha

Kya bolun, bebé?
Tu samajh gayi
Mera ishara
Seedha tere liye
